name: Tampines West Edge
summary: West edge of Tampines toward Bedok Reservoir — denser new-town living with DTL hops and community-sport catchment.
body: Tampines West Edge is the shortlist when denser Tampines convenience and DTL access matter more than quiet reservoir weekends alone. The pocket sits on the Tampines West / Bedok Reservoir edges; housing mixes newer HDB, ECs, and selective condos. Expats land here for hub errands, school options, and ActiveSG cricket-net catchment without CBD premiums. Watch-outs: sprinkler / fire-shutter test calendars on towers, school-run traffic, and confusing Tampines vs Tampines West Edge shortlists. Compare with Bedok Reservoir Fringe for park-connector calm, Simei North for quieter east-rail texture, and Tampines proper when mall gravity wins.
